title: Sep 23 Results + Sep 24 Preview: When the Model Finds Its Balance
summary: A perfectly split 8-8 day on Sep 23, plus tomorrow's Pirates showdown with Paul Skenes

content.value:
## Here's the Thing About .500 Baseball

Sometimes the model gives you days where everything clicks. And sometimes... well, sometimes you get a day like September 23rd. We went 8-8, finishing at exactly 50%, and honestly? There's something almost poetic about landing right in the middle.

## The Highs and Lows

Our highest confidence picks told an interesting story. The Yankees, Sox, and Braves all came through at 60% confidence—those felt good. Really good. The model saw something in those matchups, and the baseball gods agreed.

But here's where it gets humbling: we also whiffed on a 60% Tigers pick and a 59% Sox play against the Royals. Baseball has a way of keeping you honest, doesn't it?

## The Baltimore Bright Spot

Can we talk about the Orioles for a second? They swept our doubleheader picks against the Jays, even at relatively modest confidence levels of 54% and 51%. Sometimes it's not about the loudest picks—it's about the steady ones that just keep delivering.

## Tomorrow's Top Pick: The Paul Skenes Factor

Now, let's talk about September 24th. The model is pointing us right back to Pittsburgh, where the Pirates host the Cardinals again. And here's what makes this compelling: Paul Skenes is on the mound.

Skenes has been one of baseball's most electric stories this season, and he's going up against Kyle Leahy. The confidence sits at 51%—basically a coin flip with the slightest edge to Pittsburgh. But when you've got a talent like Skenes pitching at home, sometimes that slight edge is all you need.

content.title: ⭐ Tomorrow's Top Pick - Sep 24
content.sub: 51% win probability · Paul Skenes vs Kyle Leahy · Home advantage

content.value:
## The Takeaway

A 50% day isn't what we aim for, but it's a reminder that this game is beautifully unpredictable. We got our high-confidence picks right more often than not, stayed competitive across the board, and now we get to watch one of baseball's brightest young arms tomorrow.

That's the thing about baseball—and about predictions. You take your wins, learn from your misses, and show up ready for the next pitch.

See you tomorrow. Let's see what Skenes can do. ⚾

author: Hana
